method: 16,050-token prompt (tools/prompt-16k.txt, Strata serve/*.py source) + 512 output tokens; 1 warmup + 3 timed runs per arm, unique first line + cache_prompt=false; medians. TTFT = first streamed token; prompt tok/s = prompt tokens / TTFT; output tok/s = (tokens-1)/(end-first token). Smoke = tools/smoke.py, 3 reps.
